custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have part A stocked at the test location and at one other location, so a change to it reaches one other location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 2.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839476-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839476-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with no message under Description or Part Number.

Step 3:

  • A small orange line appears directly under the Description box: "This also changes the description at 1 other location."
  • The Description box keeps its normal outline; it does not turn red.

Step 4:

  • A small orange line appears directly under the Part Number box: "This also changes the part number at 1 other location."
  • The orange line under Description is still shown.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and part A's row still shows its old part number and description: nothing was saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R12: “When the user changes the description and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the description at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the description at 1 other location." for one.”
  • S13-R16: “When the user changes the part number and at least one other location stocks the same Part Library entry, the dialog shows, under the field, "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations.", or "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." for one.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Description changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the description at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part number changed on a part other locations stock | "This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
